section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3) and its Malay translation, which was used in the present study to assess appearance ideals. It describes the three dimensions of the Malay version, noting that only two subscales (perceived pressure and general internalisation of appearance ideals, and the importance of different information sources) were completed by participants in the present study. The section also mentions the adequate internal consistency and convergent validity of the Malay SATAQ-3 scores.
